title: A rebuilt homepage
summary:
A homepage rebuild made projects, examples, and news easier to find, while a follow-up put useful website redirects back in place.

The homepage gained responsive layouts, new visuals, community and supporter sections, and expandable news. Project listings and integration examples were also reworked, making it easier to find things people have built and how to build your own.

The image feed, image editor, and LLM-based text transformations were reworked as part of the frontend overhaul.

Public files restored redirects from `/prompt/*` and `/p/*` to the image prompt endpoint and added routing for several site paths. The update also added a web-app manifest and crawler and funding files.

highlights.title: A new homepage
highlights.text: Find community projects, integration examples, and expandable news on the rebuilt Pollinations homepage. [Explore the site](https://pollinations.ai).
